prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE isolated WorldSim stone-age environment sprite: a pile of five chipped flint stones with restrained warm-grey facets. Input 1 and input 2 are authoritative same-family style references: delicate dark hand-ink contours, restrained translucent earthy pigment washes, hand-painted natural material shapes. Input 3 is subject and layout reference only. Re-render the subject with finer lines and quieter softer wash, lower internal contrast, no broad black shadow masses or bright ivory highlights. Preserve enough fine interior ink marks to read material. Camera overhead map view with slight visible side faces, light upper-left. Muted taupe, grey-brown and buff palette. One centered object with generous 12 percent margin on perfectly flat solid magenta #ff00ff, visible through gaps. No ground, scene, extra object, frame, label, watermark. Not vector, not photorealistic, not 3D.
